name: Dynamic Performance
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: nwrenger
description: A vanilla-preserving and lightweight performance mod that dynamically adjusts view distance, simulation distance, and the mob cap based on the server's load.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3)
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
